meta.title: Paper Reader
meta.description: A Papers tab in the right sidebar for reading PDF papers: open local files by drag-and-drop or absolute path, arXiv links/ids, or arXiv keyword search; continuous scrolling, outline jumps, in-document search and remembered position; multi-colour highlights with margin notes saved per paper; quote a selection into the conversation, or ask the agent to explain or translate it; the agent reads the current paper through the read-only paper_info, paper_outline, paper_read and paper_search tools.
